name: Louisiana

agency.name: Louisiana Office of Student Financial Assistance (LOSFA)

la_tops_gpa.label: TOPS core GPA
la_tops_gpa.description: TOPS core GPA: the 19 TOPS core units on a 4.0 scale; AP, IB, dual enrollment and designated honors courses earn one extra point (an A counts 5.0).

programs.name: TOPS Excellence
programs.summary: Louisiana's top TOPS level: a 3.5 TOPS core GPA and a 31 ACT (1390 SAT).

also: A score from a single test sitting (no superscores)
FAFSA or the TOPS online application by July 1 after graduation

award.summary: Tuition and mandatory fees, up to $12,000 a year at Louisiana public colleges or $8,500 at private ones.

programs.name: TOPS Honors
programs.summary: A 3.5 TOPS core GPA and a 27 ACT (1260 SAT).

also: A score from a single test sitting (no superscores)
FAFSA or the TOPS online application by July 1 after graduation

award.summary: The college's TOPS amount plus $800 a year.

programs.name: TOPS Performance
programs.summary: A 3.25 TOPS core GPA and a 23 ACT (1130 SAT).

also: A score from a single test sitting (no superscores)
FAFSA or the TOPS online application by July 1 after graduation

award.summary: The college's TOPS amount plus $400 a year.

programs.name: TOPS Opportunity
programs.summary: A 2.5 TOPS core GPA and a 20 ACT (1030 SAT).

also: A score from a single test sitting (no superscores)
FAFSA or the TOPS online application by July 1 after graduation

award.summary: A set TOPS amount that depends on the Louisiana college (close to tuition at most public colleges).

programs.name: TOPS Tech
programs.summary: For career and technical programs: a 2.5 TOPS Tech core GPA and a 17 ACT (920 SAT) or ACT WorkKeys Silver.

also: FAFSA or the TOPS online application by July 1 after graduation

award.summary: The TOPS Tech amount for up to two years of technical training.

programs.name: Louisiana GO Grant
programs.summary: Need-based grant for students who get a Pell Grant, from the FAFSA. The college sets the amount.

award.summary: Set by the college from its state money.

aid_steps.title: Student makes a LOSFA Student Hub account
aid_steps.summary: The LOSFA Student Hub shows the student's TOPS status and award.
how: Open the LOSFA Student Hub and create an account with the student's own email.
After senior grades are final, check the TOPS status there.
watch_out: Never type passwords or Social Security numbers into ScholarTasks.

aid_steps.title: Apply for TOPS by July 1
aid_steps.summary: The FAFSA counts as the TOPS application. Families who don't file the FAFSA can use the shorter TOPS online application instead.
how: If you filed the FAFSA, TOPS is applied for. Mark this step done.
Otherwise, complete the TOPS online application in the Student Hub by July 1 after graduation.
The last test date that counts without losing a semester is the April ACT (March SAT) of senior year.

counselor_notes: Louisiana TOPS levels: Tech (2.5 GPA, 17 ACT), Opportunity (2.5, 20 ACT), Performance (3.25, 23 ACT, +$400), Honors (3.5, 27 ACT, +$800) and Excellence (3.5, 31 ACT, up to $12,000). The TOPS core GPA uses 19 core units with an extra point for AP, IB, dual enrollment and designated honors. TOPS needs a single-sitting score (no superscores); the April ACT of senior year is the last date without losing a semester. File the FAFSA (or TOPS online application) by July 1 after graduation. TOPS only pays at Louisiana colleges.
